Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to extract any specific genealogical data from the initial search results. Instead of identifying the parents of Blanche of Portugal (Afonso III and Urraca of Castile) and her paternal grandmother (Urraca of Castile) from the available search snippets or images, it simply reported that "no specific names or details were extracted yet." This lack of data extraction in the very first step of the search process prevented the Planner from making progress and led to a cycle of redundant, non-specific searches that never yielded the required information.
